claims.excerpt: How the SOFAR Channel Carries Whale Calls Across the Ocean
claims.claim: The SOFAR channel carries whale calls across the ocean, implying that whale calls themselves can travel across an ocean basin through it.
claims.label: F2 material incorrect, unsupported or misleading
claims.evidence: In some instances low-frequency sounds carry across entire ocean basins. Hydrophones at the channel's axis can detect faraway sounds, including whale calls.
claims.narrative: The central idea is that this channel’s sound-carrying behavior makes faraway whale calls audible to hydrophones.
claims.explanation: The source supports basin-scale travel for low-frequency sounds in some instances and separately says hydrophones can detect faraway sounds including whale calls. It does not establish that whale calls themselves travel across entire ocean basins.
claims.materiality: The title combines these claims into a broader assertion about the range of whale calls.
